caption: The video captures a yellow-and-black diagonally striped press head above a matching base against a pale wall, with green, blue, and red-swirled glass marbles piled on top. A white 'Glass Ball' label appears at the left early and fades as the gap above the marbles steadily narrows. The lower cylinder and wall stay fixed, showing the head moves downward rather than the camera shifting. The head reaches the pile and presses into it, compressing the layered mound into a thinner disc between the striped surfaces. A gray mounting plate becomes visible at the top as compression continues and marbles start sliding sideways under the head. Several marbles streak left and right and some drop over the front edge, while the central layer remains squeezed beneath the descending cylinder.
